items.title: Stock Market LIVE: Sensex gains 100 pts, Nifty tops 23,300; Arvind SmartSpaces shares jump 12%
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Wednesday: In the broader markets, the Nifty MidCap and the Nifty SmallCap rose 0.29 per cent and 0.52 per cent, respectively

items.title: Jindal Supreme shares off to a solid start, list at 31% premium on BSE
items.description: Jindal Supreme's IPO was a mix of a fresh issue of ₹100 crore and an offer for sale of ₹25 crore, with a total offer size of ₹125 crore. The IPO price band was set at ₹88-93 per share.

items.title: Elevate Campuses IPO gets 'neutral' call as valuations appear demanding
items.description: Elevate Campuses IPO: In the grey market, Elevated Campuses shares are trading at ₹367 apiece. This means that the listing gains could be 1.4 per cent.

items.title: Swastik Infra IPO: Analysts decode risks, valuation rationale, strategy
items.description: Most analysts are neutral on the Swastik Infra IPO as heavy dependence on government projects and customer concentration call for a 'wait and watch' mode for some time before investing.

items.title: Milky Mist Dairy Food surges 5%; up 127% from IPO price in five weeks
items.description: Milky Mist's share price hit a new high of ₹317.30, more than doubling or skyrocketing 127 per cent against its issue price of ₹140 per share.
